split_method: chronological whole dates; floor(days * TRAIN_FRACTION) for training
date_exclusion_rule: Original chronological split boundaries are preserved; only excluded CSV dates are omitted

definitions.tas: Missing historical daily tas uses the same-cell mean of originally available observations in [t-3, t+3] calendar days; observed values are unchanged; no iterative filling; windows without observations remain missing. The centered window uses future days and can cross temporal partition boundaries.
definitions.previous_large_fire: 1 if a known large fire occurred in this cell in [3 calendar years before the row date, 1 calendar year(s) before the row date); otherwise 0
definitions.previous_small_fire_neighbour: 1 if a known non-large fire occurred in a retained surrounding cell in [3 calendar years before the row date, 1 calendar year(s) before the row date); otherwise 0; unknown sizes do not count
definitions.30_day_pr: sum of pr over 30 consecutive calendar days ending on and including the row date; missing if any required observation is unavailable
definitions.is_large_fire: 1 if any reported fire in this cell on this processed fire date is >= 1000 ha; otherwise 0, including missing indicators and unknown reported fire sizes
definitions.missing_values: Missing is_large_fire indicators are replaced with 0; historical tas uses the configured centered mean fill before weather features; other missing predictor values remain unknown
definitions.fire_date: CWFIS situation report dates, except exact-ID-matched January 1 NWT 2026 placeholders use NWT estimated start dates; unmatched January 1 dates remain unchanged
definitions.fire_history_coverage: Available CWFIS reports from 2017-09-01; missing historical reporting does not establish absence
definitions.omitted_date_history: Fire reports on omitted CSV dates still contribute when they fall inside a later row's lagged history window
definitions.cell_assignment: Containing regular grid cell; outside-boundary or unretained-cell records excluded, never relocated

variable_selection.method: Descending training IV; reject when absolute Pearson correlation with an earlier retained predictor exceeds threshold
variable_selection.correlation_data: Raw training predictors; binary flags included; nominal predictors exempt
variable_selection.value_representation: Original cleaned values; no WoE transform or further imputation
